slot.brief: Ask how specific conductance behaves on dilution and why molar conductivity increases; statement/option based.

stem: Which statement is correct for an aqueous solution of a strong electrolyte on dilution?
options: Specific conductance decreases and molar conductivity increases
Specific conductance decreases and molar conductivity decreases
Specific conductance increases and molar conductivity decreases
Specific conductance increases and molar conductivity increases

verdicts.working: On dilution, ions per unit volume decrease, so specific conductance decreases; molar conductivity increases as ionic interactions lessen.

working:
Dilution decreases the number of ions per unit volume, so specific conductance decreases. Molar conductivity increases because the ions move more freely due to reduced interionic attractions.

Independent check: On dilution, ions per unit volume decrease, so specific conductance decreases; molar conductivity increases as ionic interactions lessen.
solution: Specific conductance depends on the number of ions per unit volume, which decreases on dilution; hence it decreases.\nMolar conductivity increases because reduced interionic attractions allow the ions to move more freely.
